name: Betray the Colony
description: You secretly work against the survivors. You win when colony morale reaches 0.

name: United We Stand
description: Survive the scenario with the colony's morale above 2.

name: Feed the Colony
description: Ensure the colony has at least 3 food when the scenario ends.

name: Zombie Hunter
description: Kill at least 5 zombies over the course of the game.

name: Fortify
description: Have at least 3 barricades spread across all locations when the scenario ends.

name: Keep Everyone Alive
description: Ensure no survivor is exiled or eliminated by the end of the game.

name: Hoarder
description: Have at least 4 item cards in your hand when the scenario ends.
